Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 78. key is Db, and scale is major. Instrumental Lo-fi Hip-Hop / Chillhop.
Global Emotional Progression: The piece stays calm and even from start to end: a warm, slightly nostalgic glow that never pushes for attention, with only small changes in density to keep it alive.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: Background music for coding, studying or reading late at night, rain on the window, a desk lamp and a cup of tea.
Sonics & Production Profile: Bedroom production with a muddy, warm texture: vinyl crackle, light tape hiss and gentle wow-flutter, low-passed highs, soft-clipped drums, rounded low end. Narrow dynamics, no sudden peaks.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: None. The track is purely instrumental: no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir, no vocal chops or vocal samples.
Lead Instrument: A mellow Rhodes electric piano with slow chorus carries short, relaxed melodic phrases; a muted jazz guitar answers between them.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: Rhodes chords with jazzy seventh and ninth extensions form the harmonic bed from the first bar to the last. Secondary: the muted guitar adds sparse licks in the main sections; a soft vibraphone appears in the middle section and leaves before the return.
Groove & Foundation Progression: Intro: rain and vinyl noise with Rhodes chords alone. Main section: dusty boom-bap drums with a soft kick, lazy swung snare and brushed hi-hats, plus a round sub bass. Middle section: the kick and snare drop out, only hi-hats and bass keep the pulse. Return: the full beat comes back unchanged. Outro: the drums stop, the Rhodes and crackle fade out.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Constant vinyl crackle and faint rain ambience, short tape-delay throws on guitar phrase endings, small room reverb.

Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 60. key is A, and scale is major. Instrumental Ambient / Drone.
Global Emotional Progression: A slow, weightless drift with no tension and no climax; the texture breathes and evolves gradually, slightly brighter in the middle and dissolving softly at the end.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: Deep-focus background for long thinking sessions, writing, or quiet early mornings; wide empty landscapes, mist over water.
Sonics & Production Profile: Very wide and deep stereo field, long lush reverb tails, soft attacks everywhere, warm low-mids and airy but gentle highs. Very low, steady loudness.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: None. The track is purely instrumental: no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir, no vocal chops or vocal samples.
Lead Instrument: No real melody: slowly shifting synthesizer pads and a soft, distant felt piano playing single notes now and then.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: layered analog-style pads with slow filter movement are present from beginning to end. Secondary: a bowed-string-like texture swells in the middle section; sparse felt piano notes appear in the second half and fade with the pads.
Groove & Foundation Progression: No drums and no beat at all. Only a very soft sub-bass drone underneath the pads, rising and falling with the harmony.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Granular shimmer, tape-loop textures, distant field-recording ambience (wind, faint birds), long reverb washes.

Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 70. key is E, and scale is minor. Instrumental Neo-Classical / Contemporary Classical.
Global Emotional Progression: Introspective and gentle at the start, gradually warming as strings join, reaching a modest, tender swell in the middle before settling back into calm, reflective stillness.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: Thinking, reading, writing or problem solving; a quiet room with soft daylight, slow snowfall outside.
Sonics & Production Profile: Intimate close-miked sound: the soft mechanical noise of a felt-dampened upright piano, natural room tone, a small chamber hall reverb on the strings. Wide dynamics but never loud.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: None. The track is purely instrumental: no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir, no vocal chops or vocal samples.
Lead Instrument: A felt piano plays a simple, repeating arpeggiated motif and a slow singing melody.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: felt piano arpeggios carry the harmony from the first to the last bar. Secondary: a cello enters in the second section with long sustained lines; violins and viola join for the middle swell and drop out again; the cello holds the last note with the piano.
Groove & Foundation Progression: No percussion. The pulse comes only from the steady piano arpeggios; the strings add slow legato motion in the middle section.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Gentle piano pedal noise and hammer sounds, soft string harmonics, warm natural reverb.

Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 92. key is Bb, and scale is major. Instrumental Jazz / Piano Trio.
Global Emotional Progression: Relaxed and warm throughout, with a light, conversational energy; a little more animated during the solos, then back to a calm restatement of the theme.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: A quiet jazz bar early in the evening or a cozy home office; background for work that needs calm concentration.
Sonics & Production Profile: Natural, acoustic small-room recording with warm tape character, realistic stereo placement of the three instruments, soft dynamics, no compression artifacts.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: None. The track is purely instrumental: no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir, no vocal chops or vocal samples.
Lead Instrument: An acoustic grand piano states the theme with gentle block chords and single-note lines, then improvises a calm solo.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: piano for the theme, comping and the main solo. Secondary: an upright double bass walks under the solos and takes a short melodic solo; brushed drums accompany from start to end.
Groove & Foundation Progression: Medium swing with brushes on the snare, soft ride cymbal and feathered kick. Head: theme over walking bass. Solos: piano solo then a short bass solo with light comping. Head out: theme returns, final ritardando and a soft sustained chord.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Subtle room reverb, quiet brush swishes, occasional soft cymbal swells at section changes.

Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 90. key is G, and scale is minor. Instrumental Downtempo / Trip-Hop / Chill Electronic.
Global Emotional Progression: Moody and smooth, a hypnotic steady groove that slowly deepens; a slightly darker middle section, then the main groove returns and fades into atmosphere.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: Evening work sessions, city lights through the window, a slow drive at dusk.
Sonics & Production Profile: Deep, wide mix with a heavy but soft sub bass, crisp yet gentle percussion, warm saturated keys, dub-style space. Consistent moderate loudness.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: None. The track is purely instrumental: no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir, no vocal chops or vocal samples.
Lead Instrument: A Rhodes electric piano and a clean, reverb-soaked electric guitar share short, sparse melodic motifs.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: deep sub bass and Rhodes chords carry the track from start to end. Secondary: the clean guitar enters in the main section; a dark analog pad and a muted trumpet-like synth line appear in the middle section and leave before the outro.
Groove & Foundation Progression: Laid-back broken beat with a fat round kick, a dry snare with rim clicks, shuffled hi-hats and light percussion shakers. The intro has no drums; the beat drops in after a short filter sweep and stays steady.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Dub delays on snare hits and guitar notes, spring reverb, filtered vinyl noise, slow tape-stop at the very end.

Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 86. key is F#, and scale is minor. Instrumental Synthwave / Chillwave.
Global Emotional Progression: Nostalgic, dreamy and steady, a gentle forward motion like a night drive; a slightly brighter lift in the middle, then a soft fade.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: Late-night coding, neon reflections on wet streets, an empty highway at night.
Sonics & Production Profile: Lush 80s-inspired analog production: warm detuned synthesizers, gated reverb on the snare, chorus-wide pads, smooth rounded highs and no harshness.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: None. The track is purely instrumental: no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir, no vocal chops or vocal samples.
Lead Instrument: A soft analog lead synth with gentle portamento plays a simple, slow melody; an arpeggiator sequence keeps the motion.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: a pulsing analog bass and a steady arpeggio run from start to end. Secondary: wide pads enter after the intro; the lead synth carries the theme in the main sections and rests in the middle; a bell-like synth adds a counter-melody in the final section.
Groove & Foundation Progression: Mid-tempo LinnDrum-style beat: soft kick, gated snare on two and four, steady eighth-note hi-hats. The intro has only the arpeggio and pads; the outro removes the drums first.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Gated reverb, tape-style chorus, slow filter sweeps between sections, faint cassette hiss.

Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 100. key is D, and scale is major. Instrumental Post-Rock / Ambient Rock.
Global Emotional Progression: Starts quiet and contemplative, builds very slowly in layers to a warm, luminous but restrained peak, then gently comes down to quiet again.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: Long focused work sessions, mountain landscapes at sunrise, a calm sense of progress.
Sonics & Production Profile: Spacious band recording: clean electric guitars with long delays, a warm bass, natural drums with room ambience, soft synth pads underneath. The peak stays warm and never distorted or loud.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: None. The track is purely instrumental: no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir, no vocal chops or vocal samples.
Lead Instrument: Two clean electric guitars interlock with delayed, repeating melodic patterns; one plays a slow, singing theme with an e-bow-like sustain.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: the interlocking delayed guitars run through the whole piece. Secondary: bass enters in the second section; soft synth pads and a glockenspiel join for the peak; at the end only one guitar remains.
Groove & Foundation Progression: The intro has no drums. Drums enter with soft toms and mallets on cymbals, then a gentle steady rock beat for the peak, then fall back to mallets and stop before the last guitar notes.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Long ambient delays and reverb, swelling volume-pedal guitar notes, soft cymbal rolls at transitions.

Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 96. key is C, and scale is major. Instrumental Acoustic Folk / Fingerstyle Guitar.
Global Emotional Progression: Warm, bright and peaceful, with a quiet optimism that grows slightly in the middle and returns to simplicity at the end.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: Morning work, a sunny kitchen, a walk in the countryside, light concentration.
Sonics & Production Profile: Natural, intimate acoustic recording: close-miked steel-string guitar with finger noise, a warm cello, soft room reverb, gentle dynamics.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: None. The track is purely instrumental: no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir, no vocal chops or vocal samples.
Lead Instrument: A fingerpicked steel-string acoustic guitar plays a flowing pattern with the melody on the high strings.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: the fingerpicked guitar from the first to the last bar. Secondary: a cello adds long lines in the second section; a second acoustic guitar adds soft strummed chords and a light mandolin adds a counter-melody in the middle section; the end returns to solo guitar.
Groove & Foundation Progression: No drum kit. A soft hand percussion (shaker and a cajon played gently) supports the middle section only.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Light room reverb, natural string squeaks, warm low-mids.

Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 118. key is A, and scale is minor. Instrumental Minimal Deep House / Lounge.
Global Emotional Progression: Hypnotic and steady, a smooth, unobtrusive pulse that keeps energy up without excitement; small changes in texture every few phrases, a short breakdown, then the groove returns.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: Focused work requiring momentum, a calm open-plan office, a rooftop lounge at sunset.
Sonics & Production Profile: Clean, polished, deep mix with a round sub bass, soft four-on-the-floor kick, airy percussion, warm chords. Moderate compression, consistent loudness without aggression.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: None. The track is purely instrumental: no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir, no vocal chops or vocal samples.
Lead Instrument: Short, filtered chord stabs from a warm electric piano and a soft synth carry the harmonic motif; no lead melody.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: kick, sub bass and chord stabs run through the whole track. Secondary: a dub-chord echo and a soft pad enter in the second section; a mallet synth arpeggio appears after the breakdown.
Groove & Foundation Progression: Steady four-on-the-floor kick, off-beat open hi-hats, soft claps on two and four, shakers and congas. Breakdown: the kick drops out, only pads and chords remain, then the groove returns with a gentle filter sweep. Outro: elements leave one by one.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Dub delays, slow low-pass filter automation, subtle white-noise sweeps at transitions.

Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 126. key is D, and scale is major. Instrumental Bossa Nova / Jazz.
Global Emotional Progression: Light, gentle and sunny, softly swaying; a slightly more animated middle section with a flute solo, then a relaxed return to the theme.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: A quiet café in the afternoon, relaxed work with a coffee, a balcony in summer.
Sonics & Production Profile: Warm, natural acoustic recording with a close nylon guitar, soft brushed percussion, round upright bass, gentle room reverb.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: None. The track is purely instrumental: no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir, no vocal chops or vocal samples.
Lead Instrument: A nylon-string classical guitar plays the bossa rhythm and a soft melodic theme; a flute takes the solo.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: the nylon guitar plays bossa nova comping from start to end. Secondary: an upright bass supports throughout; a flute plays the theme second time and improvises in the middle section; a soft piano adds light chords in the last section.
Groove & Foundation Progression: Classic bossa nova groove with brushes on the snare, cross-stick rim clicks and a soft kick on the bossa pattern, a light shaker. No drum fills, very steady.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Subtle room reverb, soft breath noise on the flute, warm analog tone.

Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 96. key is E, and scale is major. Instrumental Electronica / IDM / Chill Electronic.
Global Emotional Progression: Curious, warm and slightly melancholic; a gently evolving piece with small surprises in texture, a soft lift in the middle, and a hazy fade.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: Creative work and coding, autumn afternoons, old home-video memories.
Sonics & Production Profile: Warm, slightly degraded analog sound: detuned tape synths, soft saturated drums, gentle pitch wobble, wide stereo. Mellow highs, warm low end, steady loudness.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: None. The track is purely instrumental: no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir, no vocal chops or vocal samples.
Lead Instrument: A detuned analog synth lead plays a simple, slow, nostalgic melody; a music-box-like bell sound echoes it.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: warm detuned pads and a round analog bass from beginning to end. Secondary: the synth lead enters after the intro; bell and glitchy textures appear in the middle section; the end keeps only pads and bell.
Groove & Foundation Progression: Soft hip-hop-influenced beat with a warm kick, a crunchy but quiet snare and clicky micro-percussion. The intro has no beat; the middle section adds a light shuffling percussion layer.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Tape wobble, granular glitches, reversed pad swells at transitions, long reverb on bells.

Global Metadata
Basic Attributes: bpm is 95. key is G, and scale is major. Instrumental World Chill / Organic Downtempo.
Global Emotional Progression: Bright, peaceful and organic, a light rhythmic flow that feels like a garden in the morning; a slightly richer middle section, then a calm ending.
Application Scenarios & Imagery: Calm focused work, a greenhouse or garden, light morning sun, gentle water sounds.
Sonics & Production Profile: Natural, organic production: close-miked wooden and metal percussion, soft acoustic bass, warm pads, wide stereo, gentle dynamics.
Vocal Details
Vocal Gender & Timbre: None. The track is purely instrumental: no singing, no humming, no spoken words, no choir, no vocal chops or vocal samples.
Lead Instrument: A kalimba plays a repeating melodic ostinato; a marimba answers with a soft, rolling melody.
Arrangement
Instrument Lifecycle Description (Primary/Secondary Layering):
Primary: the kalimba ostinato runs from start to end. Secondary: soft marimba melody in the main sections; a warm acoustic bass and a low pad enter after the intro; a bansuri-like flute adds a few long notes in the middle section.
Groove & Foundation Progression: Light organic percussion: soft frame drum, shakers, finger cymbals and hand claps played gently. No drum kit. The intro and outro have only kalimba and nature ambience.
Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX: Birdsong and soft water ambience, light reverb, natural instrument resonance.
